title: Understanding the Update Rule
text:
The update rule for logistic regression with L2 regularization is given by:

$${	heta}^{t+1}=\left(1-2\lambdaight) {	heta}^t+\alpha \left(y_i-\operatorname{\sigma}\left(X_i {	heta}^tight)ight) X_i$$

Focus on understanding each component of this equation. What does each term represent?

title: Exploring the Sigmoid Function
text:
The term $$\operatorname{\sigma}\left(X_i {	heta}^tight)$$ represents the sigmoid function, which is defined as:

$$sigma(z)= rac{1}{1+exp\left(-zight)}$$

Try calculating sigma for a given value of $$z$$. How does this affect the update rule?

title: Effect of Regularization
text: The term $$\left(1-2\lambda\right) {\theta}^t$$ is influenced by the regularization parameter lambda. Consider how different values of lambda (positive, zero, negative) might affect the update of theta.
